mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( user_id, total_amount, address_id, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{addressId}, #{status}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status AS status,
MIN(oi.product_name) AS firstProductName, MIN(oi.option_summary) AS firstOptionSummary, COUNT(*) AS itemCount
FROM orders o JOIN order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.order_id AS orderId, o.created_at AS orderedAt, o.user_id AS buyerId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.option_summary AS optionSummary, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, o.status AS orderStatus, oi.supplier_status AS supplierStatus
FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sku s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
